meta.title: Free AI Generation Tools: Verified Free Tiers
meta.description: Real free tier numbers for AI image, video, 3D, text and audio generation tools: how much you get, how often it refreshes, whether you need an account, API access, and commercial use terms. Checked by hand, with dates and sources.
meta.notes: Confidence: high = read from an official pricing/help page; medium = consistent third-party or partially official; low = single third-party source. Items marked 'conflict' have contradictory official sources: verify by testing your own account before relying on them.
